The overall availability of transmission pipeline to transport natural gas from production
areas to customers and other areas was 100% for all transmission. The utilization was
11.18%, 76%, 23.6% for TPDC, Songas and M&P owned infrastructures. The outage
ranges between 0 for TPDC and 1 for Songas which is within best industrial practices.
